% symbolic x coords with ybar and xtick=data: names map to their
% positions; tick labels are the names. Behaviour X1.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar, symbolic x coords={low,mid,high}, xtick=data, ymin=0]
  \addplot coordinates {(low,2) (mid,3) (high,1)};
  \addplot coordinates {(low,1) (mid,2.5) (high,2)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
